construction_accounting.enumeration_basis: Source call-path counts: initial build expected_keys plus validate_scope, then two each for normal/support-drift/control-drift audits; manifest drift rejects at read_stage before key construction. Positive keys: three in build, two each normal/support audit, one in failing control audit.
construction_accounting.retention_basis: Initial support build retains one prepared context, one receipt/bank, support mask and full key list, constructed score rows and domain-reference rows; these are multiple representations, not independent repeated context builds. The full return retains only synthetic score. Postguards retain baseline score plus at most one mutation copy plus one audit-loaded score; prior mutation and rejection traceback graphs are released/collected before the next mutation. Serialized JSON/envelope buffers and native validation temporaries add memory; no measured allocator/RSS bound is claimed.

CPU_test_proposal.rationale: Prior complete Task3 dual-environment observer took 209 seconds at 2 CPUs/8 GiB. Only 25 distinct Task4 cases run here, but the single full path per interpreter reconstructs 59652 native rows/3396 controls, reads original groups/bank, repeats original audits, and materializes full temporary artifacts. 2 CPUs retain pinned one-thread behavior; 16 GiB proposes headroom over prior 8 GiB fixture allocation; 360 seconds per interpreter plus 180 seconds observer overhead bounds this unmeasured integration. Root must review or revise this proposal before dispatch; timeout preserves failure and never retries.
